description: This file defines deprecated types and constants related to test suite summaries, setup, specifications, and failures for the Ginkgo testing framework, facilitating transition from v1 to v2.

classes.name: DeprecatedSuiteSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of a test suite, including counts of specs and runtime.

classes.name: DeprecatedSetupSummary
classes.description: Represents a setup component's summary, including its type, location, state, and output.

classes.name: DeprecatedSpecSummary
classes.description: Represents a test specification's summary, including status, measurements, and output.

classes.name: DeprecatedSpecFailure
classes.description: Details about a test failure, including message, location, and related component info.

classes.name: DeprecatedSpecMeasurement
classes.description: Stores measurement data for a test spec, including statistical results and formatting.

methods.name: HasFailureState
methods.description: Checks if the spec summary has a failure state.

methods.name: TimedOut
methods.description: Indicates whether the spec has timed out (always false in this deprecated context).

methods.name: Panicked
methods.description: Checks if the spec state indicates a panic.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the spec state indicates failure.

methods.name: Passed
methods.description: Checks if the spec state indicates success.

methods.name: Skipped
methods.description: Checks if the spec was skipped.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Checks if the spec is pending.

methods.name: PrecisionFmt
methods.description: Returns a format string for printing measurement results based on precision.
